repository_summary: Aspose.3D FOSS for Java is a free, open-source Java library compatible with Aspose.3D for Java, supporting import/export of glTF, STL, and Collada formats. It targets Java developers building 3D scene processing applications and requires Java 21+. The project is MIT-licensed, actively maintained, and available on Maven Central. Limitations include incomplete rendering and commercial-API parity.
